decisions.decision: Approach C ($derived.by over per-field page.params/route/url reads) is the proposed primary shape
decisions.rationale: The production trap documented in getRoute.svelte.ts:18-30 is specifically about toStore's render_effect short-circuit on object-reference equality. Pure $derived.by per-field reads don't go through toStore and track each field independently — bypasses the trap by construction. CONVENTIONS Patterns 1+2 + Spike 002 dataRoot precedent back this.

decisions.decision: Single spike with multiple variants in the same route, not separate spikes
decisions.rationale: All variants answer the same question (does rune-native getRoute survive the navigation cascade?) with different mechanisms. Side-by-side comparison gives the cleanest signal.
